source.title: arXiv 2110.01562: Enhancing voluntary motion with modular, backdrivable, powered hip and knee orthoses

revision: not stated; predates the V3.0 KV100 in the catalog
methodNote: Static backdrive: an analog torque wrench turns the unpowered output until it moves. Dynamic: the output driven by hand at 1 and 2 Hz over 70°.

rig.torqueSensor: analog torque wrench (Neiko 03727A); rotary load cell bench for the friction model

note: Reported only as under 0.5 N·m static, so it is entered as 0.25 ± 0.25 N·m to cover 0 to 0.5 N·m. Dynamic backdrive stayed under 2 N·m at 1 to 2 Hz, rising with frequency from inertia.
